description: Evaluate current-mode cases by default, or select historical saved-snapshot mode (at most 20 cases). Eligible cases consume model tokens; neither mode files tickets. A corpus of 10 or fewer cases runs synchronously and this call returns the completed run directly. A larger corpus (this is the path a real 50-case corpus takes) instead returns a QUEUED run immediately — poll it with anyforge_get_triage_eval_run until status is completed or halted_payment_required. Historical missing evidence is unavailable; inspect historicalCoverage and historicalVerdict.

audience.description: Defaults to internal. Recorded on the run for interpretability.

caseIds.description: Run only these case ids. Omit to run every case for this company.

contextMode.description: Defaults to current. Historical reads only saved, cutoff-eligible source snapshots; missing history is unavailable. Still spends model tokens for eligible cases.

name: anyforge_run_triage_eval
title: Run triage eval
